<img src="https://thirteenag.github.io/screens/usm/main2.jpg" width="760" alt="Ultimate Spider-Man Widescreen Fix">

**Ultimate Spider-Man Widescreen Fix** corrects widescreen aspect ratio, field of view, and video scaling, with optional HUD correction that removes the radar map.

[Website](https://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#usm) · [Source Code](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/UltimateSpiderMan.WidescreenFix/dllmain.cpp) · [Default INI](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/data/UltimateSpiderMan.WidescreenFix/scripts/UltimateSpiderMan.WidescreenFix.ini)

</div>

---

## Fixes

- **Aspect ratio** — Correct widescreen aspect ratio scaling.
- **HUD** — Partial correction; the radar map is removed when the HUD fix is enabled.
- **Field of view** — Adjust the field of view for widescreen.
- **Videos** — Correct FMV scaling for widescreen.

## Options

- **Frame rate** — Set the frame rate limit in the INI file.
- **Field of view** — Adjust the FOV multiplier in the INI file.

---

## Installation

1. Download the fix archive from this release.
2. Extract the archive into the game folder, beside the game executable, preserving the folders in the archive.
3. Optionally edit `scripts/UltimateSpiderMan.WidescreenFix.ini` to configure the fix.
4. Launch the game.
